annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministère de l'Économie, des Finances et de la Souveraineté industrielle, énergétique et numérique (France)
annotation.summary_en: French government press release (31 January 2025) announcing INESIA, a national institute for AI evaluation and security, led by SGDSN and DGE. It federates ANSSI, Inria, LNE and PEReN without a new legal entity, and links France to the international AI Safety Institutes network.
key_provisions_or_claims: INESIA created to federate national AI evaluation and security actors without a new legal structure
Piloted by SGDSN and DGE; members include ANSSI, Inria, LNE, PEReN
Work covers systemic risk analysis for national security, support for AI regulation implementation, and model performance/reliability evaluation
France joins the international network of AI Safety Institutes
Follows the May 2024 Seoul Declaration priorities
annotation.title_clean: Le Gouvernement annonce la création de l'Institut national pour l'évaluation et la sécurité de l'intelligence artificielle (INESIA)
annotation.title_en: The Government announces the creation of the National Institute for AI Evaluation and Security (INESIA)
